record.title: Compare typed content inventories and expose redacted archive CLI commands
record.intent: Reuse exact added removed and changed file evidence across experiment-specific verifiers.
requirements: Model file additions removals and modifications as named alternatives with deterministic ordering and explicit unchanged counts; do not infer renames or semantic equivalence from hashes.
Add thin Click commands and typed delegates that consume archive inventories and render TOML without file contents or host paths.
Reproduce the preserved first ordinary-option logical delta from pinned before and after archives while leaving the legacy verifier byte-identical.
Exercise public library and CLI from installed wheels outside the checkout and document content-only limits separately from option or reboot claims.
acceptance: A reusable offline delta agrees with retained evidence and rejects inconsistent input.
